scripts.frontend:pnpm_install: npm run check-pnpm && cd frontend && pnpm install
scripts.build: if [ -d 'drive/public/frontend/assets' ] && [ -z "$FORCE_REBUILD" ]; then echo '[skip-build] pre-built artifacts present at drive/public/frontend/assets (set FORCE_REBUILD=1 to force rebuild)'; else npm run build:force; fi
scripts.build:force: npm run check-pnpm && cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm build
scripts.upgrade-frappeui: cd frontend && pnpm add frappe-ui@latest && cd ..
